text: The Pellham Municipal Council on Tuesday rejected the harbour levy by a vote of 13 to 12, ending a six-week fight over the waterfront repair fund and a proposed increase in berth fees. The decisive no came from Councillor Mirek Dane, who cited the finance committee’s own memorandum, dated 14 May, warning that projected dock revenues were “too uncertain” to support the borrowing plan. Mayor Alina Voss acknowledged the result after the clerk read the tally aloud in chambers, where local shipwrights and market vendors had packed the gallery. Council records show the measure would have raised 4.8 million crowns for quay reinforcement, dredging and lighting upgrades.
